name: certscore-website-privacy-preflight
description: Evidence-backed public-website privacy preflight with fast cookie/tracker previews, typed GPC comparisons, and bounded Accept and Reject observations.

interface.longDescription: Use CertScore.ai MCP Light to run or reuse a bounded public-website scan. New scans may quickly return a clearly labeled preliminary cookie/tracker preview while the canonical report is still being prepared. Continue through completion for final returned totals, findings, provenance, coverage limitations, consent controls, a jurisdiction-neutral GPC response comparison, policy signals, HTTPS/TLS, and—on eligible sites—typed results from separately authorized bounded Accept and Reject observations. Accept is a score-neutral behavior baseline; Reject can support a finding only from confirmed qualifying evidence.
defaultPrompt: Scan https://ergoveritas.com/test1.html. Show the preliminary cookie/tracker preview, then continue to the final report.
Review https://ergoveritas.com/test2.html for its typed GPC response and pre-consent cookie evidence.
Compare the bounded Accept and Reject Path observations for https://ergoveritas.com/test3.html.
